desc:
THE CREATOR — BETA 3.4

You are the god of a small round world. Your people spread across it on their own: they farm, build towns, discover flight, take up religions, trade and go to war. Every building and ship is designed for them.

Send rain or lightning. Raise mountains, flood valleys, call down meteors. Answer prayers or refuse them. Step down and live as one of them.

NEW IN 3.4
• Motherships over your capital
• Halloween and the walking dead
• Robots, AI uprisings and smarter peoples
• Fly starfighters, rockets and race courses
• Great works, secrets and living towns
• Bug fixes and so much more

Beta: bugs are expected. Feedback recommended.
